question:
The percentage of nitrogen in the air is about

A. 74%

B. 76%

C. 78%

D. 80%
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Option 3**__ i.e __**C**__.

__
 
• Nitrogen is a colorless, odorless gas and is generally considered an inert element.
 
• It can also be used in food packaging for freezing and preserving.
 
• **Nitrogen __**__constitutes __**__about 78 percent__ of the air in the atmosphere.**
 
• Nitrogen (N) atomic number is 7
